description: JSON Patch / Merge Patch apply — Apply a patch to a JSON document, fully offline. Supports RFC 6902 JSON Patch (array of add, remove, replace, move, copy, test operations with RFC 6901 JSON Pointer paths incl. ~0/~1 escapes and the - array append) and RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch (object: null deletes, objects merge recursively). Required: doc= (JSON text) and patch= (JSON text). Optional: mode=auto|json-patch|merge-patch (auto picks json-patch for an array, merge-patch for an object). Returns the patched result, whether anything changed, per-op steps and op counts. JSON Patch is atomic: a failed test or a bad path returns HTTP 422 with the failing operation index and reason (you are not charged). Up to 200,000 characters and 1,000 operations. Pairs with /v1/util/json-diff (which produces RFC 6902 patches). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_json_patch
